responsibility: Defines the core inference-error reporting context and shared utilities for rustc_infer, exposing the `TypeErrCtxt` entry point plus common classification, formatting, and span-finding helpers used by type and region diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the implementation-heavy diagnostics entry point for general inference errors. It defines `TypeErrCtxt` and the reporting logic/helpers that interpret inference state and causes into emitted diagnostics, unlike `error_reporting/mod.rs` which only reexports the hierarchy, `errors/mod.rs` which only declares structured diagnostic payload types, and `traits/error_reporting/mod.rs` which is limited to trait-specific reports.
